svg.title: Fast live detection
svg.desc: Packets from an interface or dumpcap's stream go through tshark with ingest's field list, then a flow tracker with CICFlowMeter's rules. At first packet plus 10 ms each flow becomes an event: its packets so far, its host history and its sender. The flow encoder gives h, the detection encoder, streamed in training's 512-event batches with link memory and neighbours, gives s, and every detector head scores [h, s]; the alert rules turn scores into incidents, served at GET /detections. With --forecast the same stream feeds the live world model, served at GET /forecast. A verdict comes about 31 ms after a flow's first packet.
